title: 44px hit areas for small and link buttons
summary: Button size `sm` (36px) and variant `link` get the `hit-area` utility, so every button meets the 44px touch target with no visual change.

requires.why: uses the `hit-area` utility that tokens.hit-area adds to globals.css; without it the class does nothing and the touch target still fails

migration: No API change. Small buttons placed closer than 8px apart now have overlapping hit areas; keep at least `gap-2` between them.
